description.en_US: Long-term battery history and analytics integrated into the stock battery indicator. Its stock popup is replaced by Battery Trend's informational superset, and clicking the stock ring opens the detail panel. The sidebar tile is offered by edit mode; an optional bar sparkline remains off by default.
description.zh_TW: 整合進 stock 電池指示器的長期電量趨勢與分析。原生彈窗會被本模塊的資訊超集取代，點擊 stock 電量環直接開啟詳情面板；側欄磁貼可在編輯模式加入，可選 bar 趨勢線預設關閉。
description.zh_CN: 集成进 stock 电池指示器的长期电量趋势与分析。原生弹窗会被本模块的信息超集替代，点击 stock 电量环直接打开详情面板；侧栏磁贴可在编辑模式添加，可选 bar 趋势线默认关闭。

patches.content:
DelegateChoice { roleValue: "battery_trend"; AndroidQuickToggleButton {
        required property int index
        required property var modelData
        buttonIndex: root.startingIndex + index
        buttonData: modelData
        editMode: root.editMode
        expandedSize: modelData.size > 1
        baseCellWidth: root.baseCellWidth
        baseCellHeight: root.baseCellHeight
        cellSpacing: root.spacing
        cellSize: modelData.size
        name: Translation.tr("Battery trends")
        tooltipText: Translation.tr("Battery trends")
        buttonIcon: "battery_horiz_075"
        toggled: false
        mainAction: () => Quickshell.execDetached(["qs", "-c", "ii", "ipc", "--any-display", "call", "battery_trend", "toggle"])
    } }
